# telnyx_storage_kv_namespace (Data Source)

A KV namespace, a key-value store in Telnyx Storage.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `name` (String) Namespace name. May contain lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
- `record_type` (String)
- `status` (String) Provisioning status. A namespace is usable once `status` is `provision_ok`. Once deletion completes, the namespace no longer appears in the API.
- `updated_at` (String)
